title: New purge-block message sends the user to an action that can fail when the template already has plans
plain: The error message when you try to delete an archived department may point you to delete its template, but if that template already has a plan, deleting it will also fail, leaving you without a working next step from the message alone.

title: Hình dạng 4 (âm tính một mình, không ghim mã/thông điệp): E4 chỉ kiểm 'status !== 200' cho ba ca bị từ chối, trong khi evals ghi false/400
plain: The automated test that checks a rejected delete on a department still referenced by an archived plan only confirms the request failed, not that it failed with the right error code or message, so a future regression in that specific rejection could go undetected by this test.
